host.description: IP address the diod server listens on. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

port.description: TCP port number for the diod server to bind to.

export_root.description: Base directory under which export paths are resolved (unless absolute paths are used in export definitions).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

verbose.description: Enable detailed logging (true) or minimal logging (false).

exports.description: List of export definitions, each exposing a filesystem path with specific access rules.

name.description: Unique name of the export (used as mount point identifier).

path.description: Absolute or relative (to export_root) filesystem path to export.

read_only.description: If true, clients can only read from this export; otherwise, write access is allowed.

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed client hostnames/IPs or CIDR subnets. Use ['*'] to allow all.
